duration: 45-day interim urgency ordinance; extendable 10 months 15 days, then up to 12 more months
legal_basis: Ordinance No. 1594 (Govt. Code 65858) moratorium on new data center land use applications
trigger: No zoning definition for data centers; concern over scarce industrial land/resources; recent reports of a proposed 30,000-50,000 sq ft facility locally; existing small EdgeConneX colocation facility unaffected.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted 5-0 on 2026-09-16, effective immediately for 45 days; staff to report back by Oct. 21 (day 35).
affected_projects: Existing 10,000 sq ft EdgeConneX colocation facility (fiber terminal) is legally permitted/operating and unaffected.
outcome: Staff evaluating land-use definitions, environmental impacts, infrastructure capacity, and regulatory models.

date_enacted: 2026-08-25 (Board of Supervisors adopted 4-0, chair absent; signed/issued 2026-08-28)
duration: 45-day urgency ordinance; extendable up to two years total under Gov. Code 65858
legal_basis: Urgency ordinance (Govt. Code 65858), countywide moratorium on data centers
trigger: Planning Director said large-scale data centers warrant further study on water, electricity, noise, lighting impacts; no application on file.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted 4-0 (Chair Stopper absent) on 2026-08-25; runs 45 days to 2026-10-09, extendable up to two years while county studies impacts.
outcome: County staff to study data center impacts and return with recommendations, possibly a permanent ban.

duration: 45-day urgency ordinance; extension to 10 months 15 days proposed at 2026-09-15 hearing
legal_basis: Ordinance 559 (Govt. Code 65858), moratorium on data center land use entitlements
trigger: No regulatory framework for data centers in city zoning code; text substantially adapted from the City of Coachella's ordinance.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted 5-0 on 2026-08-18, 45 days, set to expire 2026-10-02. A staff report for the 2026-09-15 Council meeting recommended adopting Ordinance 560 to extend the moratorium through 2027-08-17 (10 months 15 days); whether that extension was actually adopted was not confirmed in this pass.

duration: 45-day urgency ordinance; extendable 10 months 15 days, then up to one more year
legal_basis: Urgency ordinance (Govt. Code 65858) prohibiting new data centers and expansions
trigger: Proactive measure; no pending applications. Impacts cited: water, electricity/grid, land footprint, noise, tax/job tradeoffs.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted 5-0 on 2026-08-26; staff expected to report back by Oct. 10 with findings; can be extended 10 months 15 days, then up to one more year.
affected_projects: None; no active or pending data center applications at adoption.

duration: 45-day interim ordinance; extendable 10 months 15 days, then up to one more year (max 2 years)
legal_basis: Bill No. 1061-C.S. (interim ordinance, Govt. Code 65858), covers inland and coastal zones
trigger: No projects proposed; grid/electricity, water, noise, carbon footprint, coastal water-quality effects studied.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted unanimously 2026-09-01, effective immediately for 45 days to 2026-10-16; extendable.
outcome: Staff and Planning Commission to study zoning/regulatory controls.

duration: 45-day interim urgency ordinance; extendable in two phases up to two years total
legal_basis: Interim urgency ordinance (Govt. Code 65858) prohibiting new data center applications/entitlements
trigger: Received a pre-application from Amazon for a possible second facility (no formal application filed); existing Amazon data center under construction is not affected.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted unanimously 2026-09-14, effective immediately for 45 days; staff to report back before expiration.
affected_projects: Does not affect the already-approved Amazon (AWS) data center under construction in northeast Gilroy; covers any future application including a possible second AWS facility.
outcome: City to develop objective zoning/siting/operational standards for data centers.

duration: 45-day emergency ordinance; extendable up to two years total
legal_basis: Emergency ordinance (Govt. Code 65858) pausing new data center applications/entitlements
trigger: Requested by Councilmember Steve Manos after resident concerns; city zoning code does not specifically address data centers.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted unanimously 2026-08-25, effective immediately for 45 days.
affected_projects: V22 Investments LLC's Elsinore Heights Industrial Project withdrew its optional data-center use component separately, around the same time; the overall project remains under review.
outcome: City studying scale/impacts before determining regulatory approach.

legal_basis: Urgency ordinance barring new data centers (hyperscale, colocation, cloud, AI training/inference, HPC, crypto mining) in the unincorporated county
trigger: County code does not define or regulate data centers, so one could be approved via routine building permit; no applicant named.
current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23. Adopted 5-0 on 2026-09-01, effective immediately for 45 days to 2026-10-16.
